Our Story

Pest Control Built Around How Farms and Facilities Operate

Driftless Area Pest Control works with dairies, grain sites, warehouses, and industrial buildings throughout southwestern Wisconsin. Our team comes from agriculture, so we understand biosecurity, production schedules, and why a one-size spray route rarely solves the problem.

We start with a site walkthrough, then build a plan around your entry points, schedules, and pressure areas — sealing gaps and correcting attractants instead of only treating symptoms.

Industries We Serve

Facilities Across Agriculture and Industry

Every site runs differently. We build pest programs around your facility type, biosecurity needs, and production schedule — not a one-route spray checklist.

Dairy Farms

Fly and rodent programs built around barns, parlors, calf areas, and livestock movement — without disrupting milking schedules.

Grain & Feed

Bins, mills, and feed sites where insects and rodents threaten inventory, packaging integrity, and outbound product quality.

Food Processing

Inspection-led insect and facility programs that support cleaner operations and clearer food-safety conversations.

Warehouses

Targeted control for docks, racking, packaging zones, and storage areas where pests move with freight and foot traffic.

Livestock Facilities

Practical pressure reduction around hog, poultry, and livestock housing — planned around animal health and daily workflows.

Retail & Offices

Low-disruption programs that keep cockroaches, ants, spiders, and flies away from staff, customers, and common areas.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Straight answers to the questions commercial and agricultural clients
ask most often.

Do you serve homes, or only businesses and farms?

Our focus is commercial, industrial, and agricultural clients. If you manage a farm, processing plant, warehouse, or similar facility in our service area, we are set up to help.

What does “root-cause” pest control mean?

It means we look for how pests get in and what keeps them there — entry gaps, harborage, and attractants — then seal and correct those issues instead of relying only on repeated sprays.

Can you work within farm biosecurity protocols?

Yes. Our team follows site biosecurity rules, communicates with the people on the ground, and plans treatments around livestock health and facility schedules.

What is remote monitoring, and who needs it?

Remote monitoring uses electronic sensors to track pest activity between visits. It is especially useful for food processors and commercial sites that need faster alerts and audit-ready digital records.

Which areas of Wisconsin do you cover?

We serve southwestern and central Wisconsin, including Richland, Sauk, Vernon, Crawford, Grant, Iowa, Lafayette, Juneau, and neighboring counties in the Driftless Region.

How do I request an inspection or quote?

Call (608) 604-9190 or use the Request a Free Inspection form. Tell us about your facility type and location, and our team will follow up to schedule a visit.
